headline: Data Center Construction Costs in São Paulo Trail Silicon Valley
summary: Building a data center in São Paulo is 22% cheaper than in Silicon Valley, according to an index by Turner & Townsend covering 62 markets.
why: Lower regional construction and infrastructure costs can influence capital allocation by technology firms and data center operators seeking expansion in emerging markets.

impacts.name: Technology infrastructure
impacts.why: Cost advantages in São Paulo may attract data center investments.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
